title: BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears
summary: Bitcoin Magazine BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears A Nov. 5 13F shows Bank of New York Mellon held 237,100 Strive shares worth $6.97 million at Sept. 30, up 51,544 shares from June, with other large filers still due Monday. This post BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
